map.按工龄和全年劳动年限计算年度年休假天数（参考标准）。: Calculate the annual leave entitlement from length of service and the full-year working period (reference standard).
map.法定年休假按累计工作年限分档：工龄满 1 年不满 10 年为 5 天、满 10: Statutory annual leave is banded by cumulative years of service: 1 to under 10 years gives 5 days, 10 to under 20 years gives 10 days, and 20 years or more gives 15 days. Days for the current year = full-year entitlement × remaining months in the year ÷ 12. Service under 1 year earns no statutory annual leave, and the prorated result is kept to one decimal place.

map.HR 在新员工入职时，根据社保缴费记录与劳动合同推算累计工龄，确定当年法定年假档: HR works out cumulative service from social insurance records and the labour contract when a new employee joins, to set the annual leave band for that year.
map.员工自助测算全年可休天数，结合累计工龄与当年在职月份估算可用额度。: Employees self-estimate how many days they can take in the year, using cumulative service and the months in post.
map.各分支机构参照《职工带薪年休假条例》同一年限计档标准，避免人工误判。: Each branch applies the same banding in the Regulations on Paid Annual Leave for Employees, avoiding manual errors.

map.司龄与工龄如何区分？: How do company tenure and total service differ?
map.法定年假按累计工龄（含他司）计档，司龄通常只影响公司额外福利假，二者分开核算。: Statutory annual leave is banded by cumulative service including previous employers, while company tenure usually only affects extra company benefits, so the two are accounted for separately.
map.当年中途入职怎么算？: How is someone who joined mid-year handled?
map.全年都在职才给满档天数；当年仅部分在职的，按当年剩余日历天数比例折算，可用年假折: The full band is only given if you worked the whole year; if you were in post for only part of the year, prorate by the remaining calendar days, which the annual leave proration tool handles.
